{{Otheruses|Mileva}}
{{Quote|My firm, Monchantics, cleared half a billion credits in net profit last fiscal quarter. Our initial public offering hits the Mileva Stock Exchange next month.|Sibs Monchan|<ref name="Insider144">{{InsiderCite|144|Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score}}</ref>}}
[[File:SalinMariner-Insider144.jpg|thumb|right|200px|One month prior to his company's planned initial public offering on the Mileva Stock Exchange, Sibs Monchan undertook a luxury cruise aboard the ''Salin Mariner'' (pictured).]]
The '''Mileva Stock Exchange''' was a stock exchange<ref name="Insider144" /> that shared its name with the [[Mileva system/Legends|Mileva system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Maldrood sector/Legends|Maldrood sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> At one point by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="HondoDate">{{HondoOhnakaScoreDate}}</ref> [[Sibs Monchan]], the [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] owner of the highly profitable [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] interface design company [[Monchantics]], undertook a luxury cruise along<ref name="Insider144" /> the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> aboard the [[C-One liner|liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]'' while his company was one [[Standard month/Legends|month]] away from making an initial public offering on the Mileva Stock Exchange. During the cruise&mdash;in the process of which Monchan was nearly kidnapped by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and his [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]]&mdash;the HoloNet magnate noted the upcoming initial public offering to a group of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|liner's]] other first-class passengers over a shared [[Diet/Legends|dinner]].<ref name="Insider144" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mileva Stock Exchange was mentioned in [[Jason Fry]]'s short story "[[Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 144|144th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider144" /> on [[September 3]], [[2013]].<ref name="Insider144Date">[[Star Wars Insider 143|''Star Wars Insider'' 143]]</ref>
